theme_strategy.rationale: Network operations / ISP NOC dashboards and MikroTik monitoring tools (Winbox, Dude, modern NOC consoles) are predominantly used in dark mode for prolonged monitoring sessions, reducing eye strain while highlighting status LEDs (green online, red offline/isolir, amber connecting). High visual contrast with slate/obsidian surfaces and vivid status pills.

entry_surfaces./login: split branded login — left high-contrast ISP NOC brand & operational overview panel, right authentication card with role switcher quick test
entry_surfaces./: admin command shell with collapsible navigation, top metric ribbon, real-time router status pill, and dense KPI grid

visual_enhancers.status_pulse: relative inline-flex rounded-full h-2.5 w-2.5 bg-emerald-500 animate-ping opacity-75
visual_enhancers.grid_density: Mode B high density grid with tight gaps (gap-3.5 to gap-4.5) for technical NOC clarity
visual_enhancers.table_styling: dense rows with font-mono for IP/MAC/INV numbers, hover row highlight bg-slate-800/50, sticky table headers

accessibility_and_contrast.wcag_compliance: WCAG AA standard with all normal text exceeding 4.5:1 against dark slate surfaces (#F1F5F9 on #0B0F17 = 15.2:1)
accessibility_and_contrast.status_contrast: Every colored status pill uses dark tinted bg with high-luminance text (e.g. #34D399 on #064E3B = 6.4:1; #F87171 on #7F1D1D = 5.2:1)

instructions_to_main_agent: 1. Language is strictly Bahasa Indonesia throughout the entire UI (e.g. 'Pelanggan', 'Tagihan', 'Lunas', 'Belum Bayar', 'Terlambat', 'Isolir', 'Paket Internet', 'Tiket Gangguan', 'Pasang Baru (PSB)', 'Uji Koneksi MikroTik', 'Sesi PPPoE Aktif', 'Cetak Struk').
2. Setup Leaflet with 'yarn add leaflet @types/leaflet' in frontend directory before building NetworkMap component. Include Leaflet CSS import.

3. Provide realistic Indonesian ISP / RT RW Net seed data: Routerboards (RB450Gx4, CCR1009, RB750Gr3, CCR2004), realistic IP addresses (10.20.0.x, 192.168.88.1), ODP codes (ODP-GMP-01/08), rupiah amounts (Rp 150.000, Rp 250.000, Rp 350.000), Indonesian customer names and addresses.

4. Implement simulated live MikroTik API actions: 'Uji Koneksi' (Test Connection with 4 sequential verified steps), 'Isolir Pelanggan' (changes profile to 'ISOLIR' & disconnects PPPoE active session), 'Aktifkan Kembali' (restores normal profile), 'Sinkronkan Data MikroTik'.
5. Implement printable & downloadable thermal receipt dialog (format 58mm/80mm) with QR code & WA sharing template text.
6. Include Role Switcher dropdown in the top header or quick role selector on Login page so evaluators can seamlessly experience Super Admin, Admin, Finance, CS, and Teknisi views.

7. All buttons, tables, filters, and action icons MUST have kebab-case data-testid attributes (e.g. data-testid='customer-add-btn', data-testid='invoice-filter-status', data-testid='mikrotik-test-conn-btn').
UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT: Avoid generic centered layouts; use dense technical Bento/NOC grid system with crisp borders and subtle dark card elevations.
Never use pure black #000000; use rich deep slate #0B0F17 with navy undertones.
Ensure all monetary values use Indonesian Rupiah format: 'Rp 150.000' and numbers formatted with locale 'id-ID'.
Ensure MikroTik action log and WhatsApp notifications are clearly visible and interactive to demonstrate the simulated automation capabilities.
Use sonner for instant toast feedback after any action (e.g. 'Pelanggan berhasil di-isolir di MikroTik Router-Utama').
